notes.title: Happy Birthday Leo B.F.
notes.content:
[h1] Pre-Announcement[/h1]
Today is the birthday of a good friend of mine(Leo Fulvio B.), so I wanted to mention him in this first update of Old Adventure!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31255200/af72fd0425bc1e104fe0993a3dc1846624405d79.png[/img]

[h1] Old Adventure News[/h1]
The new version will be online the 11 February and it introduces new adventures and a lot of bug fixing!  
A very important news for Old Adventure is that Microsoft approved the Game Concept for release it on Xbox One. Also, I'm working very hard to make the game compatible with Mac OS X and also Linux. 

[b]HAPPY BIRTHDAY, LEO![/b]
-Stroe Andrei
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31255200/1f6367843381a374c306772a27c9b0fa4a3e600f.png[/img]
